# Montgo Health

> Montgo Health is a Dubai-based healthcare consultancy partner providing comprehensive licensing, facility planning, recruitment, and regulatory compliance services across UAE healthcare authorities (DHA, MOH, HAAD).

Montgo Health specializes in helping healthcare professionals and facilities navigate UAE's complex regulatory landscape, including licensing with Dubai Health Authority (DHA), Ministry of Health (MOH), and Health Authority of Abu Dhabi (HAAD). The company offers end-to-end support from business formation through accreditation and ongoing compliance management.

## Key Topics

- DHA (Dubai Health Authority)
- MOH (Ministry of Health)
- HAAD (Health Authority of Abu Dhabi)
- Professional licensing
- Facility licensing
- Healthcare consultancy
- UAE regulatory compliance
- DHCC (Dubai Healthcare City)
- JCI accreditation
- EMR and telemedicine
- Healthcare recruitment
- CPD/CME training
- Medical device registration
- Facility planning
- Healthcare operations

## Core Services

- [Health Professional Licensing](https://montgohealth.com/health-professional-licensing): DHA, HAAD, MOH professional licensing and compliance services
- [Health Facility Licensing](https://montgohealth.com/services/health-facility-licensing): Clinic and hospital licensing with DHA, MOH, DHCC coordination
- [Healthcare Facility Planning](https://montgohealth.com/services/healthcare-facility-planning): Clinic and hospital setup with EMR, telemedicine, and compliance
- [General Healthcare Consultancy Services](https://montgohealth.com/services/general-healthcare-consultancy-services): Healthcare consultancy for operations, compliance, and revenue management
- [Healthcare Professionals Recruitment](https://montgohealth.com/services/healthcare-professionals-recruitment): Healthcare recruitment and placement with licensing support in UAE

## Regulatory & Compliance

- [Healthcare Facility Accreditation Service](https://montgohealth.com/services/healthcare-facility-accreditation-service): JCI and Accreditation Canada compliance with gap analysis and training
- [Medical Devices & Pharmaceutical Product Registration](https://montgohealth.com/services/medical-devices-pharmaceutical-product-registration): MOHAP medical device and pharmaceutical registration with FDA, CE support
- [Exam Criteria](https://montgohealth.com/exam-criteria): Exam eligibility, requirements, and topics for healthcare professionals

## Business Setup & Operations

- [Company Formation & Documentation Assistance](https://montgohealth.com/services/company-formation-documentation-assistance): Healthcare business setup and UAE registration documentation assistance
- [Medical Equipment Leasing Assistance](https://montgohealth.com/services/medical-equipment-leasing-assistance): Medical equipment leasing and procurement for healthcare facilities
- [Healthcare PRO Services](https://montgohealth.com/services/healthcare-pro-services): Administrative support, license renewals, and government liaison services

## Professional Development

- [Training & Education Assistance](https://montgohealth.com/services/training-education-assistance): CPD, CME, and professional development for healthcare staff

## Growth & Marketing
